task: Refresh all shared photographic backgrounds with coherent premium brand photography; male or inanimate subjects only.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: premium creator-equipment website campaign background, wide 16:9 landscape photograph.
Primary request: photograph a real EMPTY professional photographic studio with a charcoal cyclorama, subtle teal colour wash along the far left edge and muted violet colour wash along the far right edge. No people or equipment. Premium cinematic photographic finish suitable for a major technology brand. A large quiet charcoal wall occupies the central 70 percent and the entire upper half for website headline overlay, with very low contrast soft gradients. A realistic matte concrete floor runs along the lower quarter, with restrained violet and teal spill visible on it; colour is deliberately subtle, not neon. Only one very low plain dark rectangular plinth near the far lower right corner may be visible. Empty centre. Real physical studio photograph with believable diffuse wall illumination and fine surface texture, never an illustration or glossy CGI. Crisp straight architecture, clean restrained composition, excellent tonal gradation, natural photographic dynamic range. Off-camera lighting sources only.
Constraints: no visible lamps, light panels, tripods, cables or recognizable product hardware; no people, human figures, silhouettes or reflections; no logos, branding, writing, packaging, watermarks, or text. No fake beam cones or glowing objects. Wide photographic image, approximately 1920 by 1080 or greater, keep the whole composition visible.
visualQA: Empty photographed charcoal studio, no people or equipment visible
Restrained teal/violet illumination is physically consistent on wall and ground
Broad centre and upper negative space allows HTML copy

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: premium creator-equipment website behind-the-scenes banner, about-page and filming-guide background. Wide 16:9 landscape documentary photograph.
Primary request: a believable professional interview film production in a minimal quiet charcoal and warm grey studio with natural soft daylight. Only TWO people are present, both clearly adult MEN. In the lower left side an adult male camera operator in a plain dark shirt is standing beside a realistic unbranded professional video camera on a sturdy black tripod. The camera is seen in clean side profile, its lens visibly points RIGHT directly toward the male interview guest in the lower right third. The male guest is comfortably seated on a neutral upholstered armchair, facing slightly LEFT toward the camera, relaxed natural expression and natural hands, wearing a plain charcoal shirt and beige trousers. Both men have short masculine hair and unambiguously male adult appearance. The camera, operator and guest form a physically coherent line of sight, lens aimed at seated guest's face, not at an empty wall. Nobody looks at the photograph's viewer. Large quiet charcoal wall across the entire upper half and the broad middle area for a white HTML headline overlay. Keep the subjects and filming hardware low and toward the sides, not in the central headline space. Real working film-set documentary photography, clean professional composition, sharp realistic camera construction, natural anatomy, controlled cinematic tonal range, beautifully diffused daylight, subtle depth of field but the camera and male guest clearly legible. Premium restrained major-technology-brand visual standard. No visible light fixtures are needed, all illumination comes plausibly from off-frame daylight.
Constraints: men only, absolutely no women or feminine figures, no feminine silhouettes, faces, hands or reflections anywhere. No visible lighting panels, lamps, reflectors, light stands or cables. No recognizable Apkina products or invented lighting hardware. No camera maker lettering or badges, no logos, branding, text, watermarks or packaging. No blue or orange packaging. No CGI or cartoon effect. Wide photographic image approximately 1920 by 1080 or greater, preserve full composition.
